structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Large strategic programs, classified integration and long qualification/production cycles create high switching friction.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Demand spans aeronautics, defense, mission and space systems, but funding and program concentration remain government-dependent.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: Replacement on major strategic programs is difficult after award, though competing primes and future architectures constrain permanent control.

adversarial-red-team.name: financialOperatingMomentum
adversarial-red-team.basis: Sales/backlog and guidance strengthened while major fixed-price/production programs still carry cost-estimation risk.

thesisQuality.basis: $104.7B-$105B record backlog, $20B Q2 awards and 5% sales growth evidence durable demand; fixed-price execution risk prevents exceptional band.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 sales rose 5% and guidance was raised, but a $157M unfavorable B-21 EAC adjustment demonstrates meaningful margin volatility.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: September 2026 market capitalization near $72-74B and share price near $509 imply a substantial mature-prime valuation; current evidence supports balanced rather than compelling asymmetry.

catalystScore.basis: Raised 2026 outlook plus conversion of record awards/backlog provide identifiable medium-term execution catalysts, offset by appropriations and program timing uncertainty.

governancePower.basis: Current disclosure identifies adverse program estimate changes alongside raised outlook rather than obscuring them; evidence supports adequate-to-strong transparency but not exceptional stewardship.

alignment2036.basis: Strategic deterrence, aerospace, missile defense, sensing and space capabilities are foundational national-security infrastructure across multiple long-duration scenarios.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Demand spans aeronautics, defense, mission and space systems using reusable integration/engineering capabilities, though the common U.S.-government customer base limits independence.

bottleneckControl.basis: Classified integration, long qualification/production cycles and major strategic programs create scarce capability and high switching friction.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Multiple defense/space mission sets diversify program exposure, but appropriations and government concentration remain correlated risks.

substitutionResilience.basis: Major awarded strategic programs are difficult to replace after qualification; competing primes and future architectures keep the score below exceptional.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Scale and long-cycle production support planning capacity, but current evidence does not establish exceptional multi-source redundancy and program ramps retain supply/production execution exposure.

pricingPower.basis: Scarce mission-critical capability supports value capture, but fixed-price production exposure can shift cost variance back to Northrop and constrains durable pass-through.

riskEvidence.basis: Primary risks are fixed-price/EAC margin charges, program concentration, appropriations timing and unfunded backlog; the fresh B-21 adjustment proves execution risk is current rather than theoretical.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Identity/tradability are validated and all score components are addressed by current primary evidence plus an independent current market observation; customer-side independent corroboration remains limited.

scoreRecord.thesis: Northrop Grumman controls difficult-to-replace strategic aerospace, deterrence and space capabilities backed by record demand, but value realization depends on disciplined conversion of long-cycle backlog into margins.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Fixed-price program execution and government funding/program concentration can turn technical or schedule variance into material margin impairment.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Execution against raised 2026 guidance and conversion of record awards/backlog, particularly major strategic production ramps.

scoreBreakdown.formula: weighted components less 0.16*risk, multiplied by confidence floor interpolation

contradictions.resolution: Demand strength and execution risk are simultaneously true; the adjustment narrows confidence in frictionless backlog-to-margin conversion but does not invalidate structural demand.
